notes.title: HOOK update is coming
notes.notes:
Hi! Hook will get a big update next month. 

I'm already creating new levels, you can check one below. 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bdURC-KtGXQ
I've also updated my page https://www.rainbowtrain.eu/ where I'll be posting news about upcoming games and updates. 

Hook 2 is almost ready and will be released by the end of June. You can wishlist it here: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1871310/Hook_2/

Thank you all for your support!

notes.title: Linux version, achievement and bug fixes.
notes.notes:
- I've added an option to re-size a window, so you can adjust it on super wide screens. 
- Linux version is out.
- Added an achievement for completing all levels. If you already did - just open a game to unlock it.
